scripts.postinstall: pnpm install --prefix api && pnpm install --prefix ui && pnpm install --prefix vscode
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix api && npm run build --prefix ui && npm run build --prefix vscode
scripts.vscode:install: npm run build && npm run package --prefix vscode && code --install-extension vscode/doty.vsix --force
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix ui" "npm run start:dev --prefix api"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run preview --prefix ui" "npm run start:prod --prefix api"
